main.description: Create or update a policy.audience record in the writer's own repository. With the rkey of an existing record the record is replaced; otherwise a record is created. Membership changes apply to every post that names the audience.

repo.description: DID of the writer's repository. Must be the authenticated account.

rkey.description: Record key. Names the record to update when it exists; a TID is generated when absent.

validate.description: Lexicon validation preference, as for com.atproto.repo.createRecord.

swapRecord.description: On update, compare and swap with the current record CID.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller may not write to this repository, or the host does not allow this account private-tier writes.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: swapRecord did not match the current record CID.
